limits: Pair correlation is conjectural and RH-conditioned. The fixed-r result is only summarized from cited prior work, assumes RH and (1.9), and gives c(log T)^(-4k), which decreases with T and must not be called a fixed positive density; its exact theta threshold is OCR-sensitive.
